root_cause: Path-limited git rev-list includes deletion commits, and git show <commit>:<path> fails for their absent paths.
fix: On a historical blob read failure, verify path absence with a literal full-tree git ls-tree lookup before skipping. Preserve the original error for a present entry or failed verification. Current-ref reads and the quote-not-found error retain their existing paths.
